messages:
mira: Heads up  supplier pushed our reserved manifest. Largest tranche deferred to late July; they attached a surcharge option for expedited airfreight.
ryan: Oof. Which reservation IDs and how many units moved?
supplier-bot: Manifest amendment: reservations [RC-10112, RC-10113, RC-10114] original dock 2026-06-14. New: quick-tranche 140 units -> 2026-06-21, deferred-tranche 260 units -> 2026-07-30. Expedited airfreight option available for +surcharge.
tom: Who's impacted customer-wise? We have a joint announcement with an SI partner on 6/24 that requires capacity for demos and a pilot.
ryan: Mapping: RC-10112 -> SI-demo pool (120 GPUs, demo 2026-06-24); RC-10113 -> Enterprise commit (160 GPUs, soft-launch 2026-06-20); RC-10114 -> internal buffer 120 GPUs. Total reserved 400 GPUs.
arun: The quick-tranche of 140 still leaves us short for the SI-demo. We can reassign 40 GPUs from a non-critical internal lab in 12h.
leah: Sales: the SI partner is public-facing and will expect the demo on 6/24. If we miss, it damages the joint announcement. We need plan A and client-facing comms.
isha: Legal: don't commit credits in the first outreach. Language ok: "we're enacting mitigations and will pursue remedies under supplier contract as needed."
ryan: Options from ops: (1) accept supplier airfreight for 120 units (dock 6/19) at surcharge; (2) short-term loan from EdgeCompute partner of 100 compatible GPUs (LOI required, crosscharge applies); (3) marketplace burst 80 GPUs for 7 days (costly). We can also mix these.
leah: EdgeCompute has been receptive historically; can we fast-track an LOI? Risk: partner GPUs are mixed-SKU.
arun: Mixed-SKU ops cost: ~6 hours validation + driver sync. If we accept, we can have them online in ~12h after receipt.
ryan: Isha, if we accept partner loan, do we need a written waiver from customer about mixed hardware?
isha: No waiver needed for the SI-demo itself, but document the hardware variance in the handoff and keep evidence of testing. If we offer credits later, coordinate with finance.
leah: I'll ping the SI partner liaison to ask about mixed-hardware tolerance for the demo. Quick ask: would they accept a 75/25 mix of internal A100-class and partner 80GB-class cards?
mira: Action list: @ryan push supplier for written airfreight ETA + surcharge breakdown. @arun inventory exact GPU SKUs in internal buffer and validation time. @leah check partner tolerance and LOI. @isha stand by for any legal paperwork. I'll draft a cautious customer note.
ryan: Supplier replied: can airfreight up to 120 units, ETA 2026-06-19 18:00 UTC, surcharge estimate provided. Need confirmation by EOD to lock.
arun: Inventory: we can free 40 internal GPUs in 12h. Internal buffer shows additional 30 idle but attached to a test cluster that needs migration (24h). So realistically 70 internal in 24h.
leah: SI liaison: they can accept mixed-hardware for the demo if we guarantee parity for the demo scenarios and share a smoke-test report. They'll sign a quick LOA to avoid public confusion.
ryan: That gets us to ~70 internal + 120 airfreight = 190, enough for SI-demo (120) and partial for enterprise commit. We still need ~30-60 to fully cover enterprise commit.
mira: Marketplace procurement for 40 units as temporary bridge? Arun, estimate ops time for marketplace spin-up.
arun: Marketplace 40 units can be provisioned in ~8h (procurement + IAM + deployment). Cost delta ~2.4x normal, but only for ~7 days.
isha: If we accept airfreight, ensure supplier puts insurance on shipment and provides Bill of Lading. Legal to review surcharge pass-through language before we ask customer to cover any costs.
ryan: Supplier replied again: airfreight confirmed pending our PO acceptance. They included a carrier SLA and insurance option.
mira: Decision: Accept airfreight for 120 units + free 70 internal + marketplace 40 = coverage. @ryan approve PO, @arun begin freeing internal and preparing marketplace request, @leah draft client-facing note emphasizing mitigations and next steps. @isha legal will prep removable language about remedies.
leah: Draft to SI partner: "We're activating mitigations to keep the demo and will provide test results by EOD. No action required on your side unless you want to request physical parity. We'll follow up with logistics details." Legal ok.
ryan: PO sent to supplier and confirmation received. Carrier insurance added. Surcharge negotiation reduced by 30% via supplier goodwill.
arun: Marketplace request submitted for 40 GPUs; provisioning ticket created. Freeing internal 70 GPUs in progress; validation run scheduled.
mira: Update: airfreight dock ETA confirmed 2026-06-19 18:00 UTC, customs buffer ok. Marketplace units expected online by 2026-06-18 04:00 UTC. All combined sources cover SI-demo and the enterprise soft-launch.
leah: Sent cautious comms to SI partner and enterprise contact with mitigation plan and promise of a post-event reconciliation.
isha: Legal: keep evidence of manifests and LOIs for any future claim. We'll coordinate with finance on surcharge amortization.
mira: Closing loop for now  postmortem to follow after the July windows settle. Please attach BOLs and invoices to the ticket.
